title.narrative: KCYPS - Accelerating a national youth-inclusive process to inform the National Action Plan on Youth Peace and Security in Kenya
KCYPS - Accelerating a national youth-inclusive process to inform the National Action Plan on Youth Peace and Security in Kenya

description.narrative: The proposed project seeks to support the Youths in the Youth and Peace and Security agenda especially in informing the process of developing a National Action Plan (NAP). The project will help ensure a coordinated and collaborative process for youth-led groups to shape and contribute meaningfully to the NAP. The project aim at addressing the problem of youth exclusion from decision-making in the field of peace and security. The project will create bridges between young leaders and key actors in the peace-building area, and reinforce the youth’s voice and contributions on youth, peace and security issues. The project is well aligned with Finland´s strategic goal in Kenya, namely skills development and political engagement on the youth, Peace and Security agenda. The project in a way complements our GIZ TVET and IFAD projects in that it will help youths shun violence and engage in productive activities, and in turn their involvement in the peace consultations can also lead to increased opportunities for education, employment and entrepreneurship. The project will target 42 counties in data collection and consultations.
